Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL4651341. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to include canonical SMILES. Return the columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
